summary: Full backend + frontend regression for Borrowed Blues. 20/21 pytest cases pass. All public pages, login flow, role-based redirects, therapist portal (dashboard, clients, calendar, requests) and client portal (dashboard, journal save, homework, appointments request) render and function correctly. One backend defect found: brute-force lockout does not trigger through the ingress because request.client.host varies across proxy pods, splitting the attempt counter.

minor.issue: Brute-force lockout keyed on request.client.host+email. Behind the K8s ingress the client IP alternates between at least two proxy IPs (10.79.151.158 / 10.79.151.159), so 6 consecutive wrong logins from the same real client produced [401,401,401,401,401,401,401] and never hit 429. Confirmed in Mongo (login_attempts had counts split 4/2 across two identifiers). Fix: honour X-Forwarded-For (first hop) or drop the IP portion and rate-limit on email alone with a small delay.

issues: Uses native browser date + time inputs (mm/dd/yyyy, HH:MM). Style guideline suggests shadcn Calendar/Time picker for editorial feel; low priority.

action_items: Fix brute-force lockout so it accumulates per real client (use X-Forwarded-For or email-only key).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 863 lines - approaching split-threshold (700). Consider splitting into routers/auth.py, routers/therapist.py, routers/client.py, seed.py.
CORS: allow_credentials=True combined with allow_origin_regex='.*' echoes any Origin; acceptable for preview but tighten in production to FRONTEND_URL only.
brute-force detection uses request.client.host without honouring X-Forwarded-For - unreliable behind ingress/LB (see backend_issues).
PATCH /therapist/appointments/{id} and PATCH /therapist/requests/{id} accept raw dict payloads with no Pydantic validation. Consider typed update models.
GET /client/resources returns all resources including is_public=False; should probably filter or respect is_public.
seed_admin_and_data correctly re-hashes admin/client passwords when env-provided password no longer matches (good, idempotent).
seed_data_creation: None beyond what backend seed produces; test data prefixed TEST_ was created (a client user, appointment, session note, homework, reflection) via API - safe to leave.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py under /app/backend/tests covers public API, auth (login/register/logout/me/forgot/lockout), role guards for all therapist+client endpoints, full therapist flow (appointments, notes, homework, requests) and client flow (dashboard, appointment request, reflection create+list, homework toggle). Playwright verified role-based redirects both directions plus logout gating. The lockout test is the only failure and needs a backend fix before it will pass end-to-end.
rca of the issue: Brute-force counter identifier = f'{request.client.host}:{email}'. K8s ingress proxies requests to the app pod from multiple worker IPs. Each request may show a different client.host, so counts never reach 5 for a single identifier. Verified in db.login_attempts. Repro: from any external client POST 6x /api/auth/login with a bogus email+password - all return 401, none return 429. Mitigation: parse X-Forwarded-For (first IP) OR key rate-limit on email only OR configure uvicorn --proxy-headers with a trusted forwarder list.
